title: Sharp Regularity Thresholds for Viscous Katz--Pavlović Dyadic Models
summary: We study the unforced viscous Katz--Pavlović dyadic model with non-negative smooth initial data for two shell settings. For super-exponential scales $N_n=N_0^{b^n}$, with $N_0>1$ and $1 (\log2)/(2\logΛ)$. In particular, for $Λ>2^{3/2}$, the result reaches $α=1/3$ and, together with the known classical blow-up theorem, identifies the sharp threshold in classical shell ratios.
